correctness.rationale: For n≥5 the cited classification reduces to the identity automorphism and the singular retractions with parameters (e,e), (1,e), and (t,e) with odd involutive t; (1,1) is the separate constant c, not the excluded identity endomorphism. Evaluating composition on odd, even and singular inputs gives the stated edges: c meets v and w, u meets v and w at the same e, v meets w there, and distinct w never commute. This makes c a cut vertex and forces distance four between u vertices with different labels; at least two labels exist. An odd transposition on two nonroots in one fiber exists for some e, so clique number three is attained. The equations te=et=e say that t fixes roots and preserves fibers, giving the stated signed product. The labeled block weight is z^(b+1)/b!, and the signed and unsigned involution EGFs give the two inner exponentials. The graphs at positive q(e) have exactly two triangles per page; only the two edges in a zero-page piece are maximal edges. H_n counts pairs with designated root and singleton blocks, excluding e=1 only when forming graph pieces. Independent labeled-block recurrence reproduces B_n coefficients through n=10 and I_5=196, B_5=180, H_5=81; the graph formulas then give 571,930,360,520. That independent check was arithmetic, not exhaustive composition testing.
residual_risks: The recurrence is finite corroboration. Correctness of the infinite claim is based on the composition and rooted-fiber proof with the cited classification. No graph classification is extended to n=4.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Retain only the retraction parameters: the constant with value 1 is the special b_0=c, nonpermutation type contributes each u_e, even type contributes v_e (only parameter 1), and odd types contribute w_(t,e). The stronger pair criterion then gives every listed edge and excludes every other one. No algebraic issue remains because the identity endomorphism was stipulated to be omitted.

evidence: Section 6 of 51c1b3fc0869 gives the product-weight rule: a sum of product weights over labeled rooted fibers is n![z^n] exp(sum_s w_s z^s/(s−1)!). Taking its own weights b_s=U^+_(s−1) and c_s=U^-_(s−1) gives exp(z exp(z+z²/2)) and exp(z exp(z−z²/2)).
Its commutation criterion already prohibits any edges between different labels except through b_0, gives the odd vertices both same-label neighbors, and makes distinct odd vertices nonadjacent.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Half the difference of those already-specified transforms is exactly the advertised EGF, including low degrees by the combinatorial weight convention. The induced graph gives two triangles per odd vertex. The condition O_e=0 is just that no fiber admits a transposition of nonroots, hence all fibers have size ≤2 and the allowed rooted-block EGF is exp(z+z²). Each such nontrivial label leaves two maximal edges. These operations yield the maximal-clique formula and other counts without a new classification or enumerative step beyond the covered data.

It is not a new parity statistic just because each is interpreted as a page of a graph here. The other paper's H_n is its total pair count, not the zero-page count in this record.

originality.rationale: The essential edge criterion is the restriction of a previously published multiplication table, and the distinct same-day joint-rank census states the stronger commuting criterion and the very same local signed product q(e)=O_e. Its rooted-block EGF transform explicitly applies to both product weights in O_e, so the B_n generating function is a direct half-difference of two transforms already used there. The remaining graph invariants follow by inspecting the graph under this restriction and summing, and the zero-page correction follows by deleting blocks of size greater than two. This is verified claim coverage and mechanical implication, not proof that the same-day comparison preceded the assigned record and not a conclusion based on inaccessible literature.
residual_risks: Same-day precedence is not established. The verified formula and implication overlap does not require determining chronology.

value.rationale: The commuting graph of this natural semigroup is a reasonable object. However, its submitted adjacency is a restriction of the known full criterion; its page statistic is literally the known local odd-type count and the same rooted-block transform determines the aggregate. The triangle and maximal-family counts require only multiplication by two and the elementary singleton/two-block exclusion from that explicit component diagram. There is no surviving independently useful new exact invariant beyond those mechanical consequences in the submitted scope. No rewrite or additional finite table would change this assessment.
residual_risks: The judgment is specific to the submitted invariants; it says nothing against a different, substantively new graph question for these endomorphisms.
